judy: Quick concept 1: an inline 'quick fallback' control on rollout pages. Single row, minimal knobs, audit-first. Goal: operator can act in <20s without opening the full policy editor. Thoughts? :eyes:
sam: Strong yes. Must display the affected route + rollout id. Otherwise folks will hit the wrong thing.
maria: Minimal controls: Mode (soft-throttle | quarantine | fallback-model), Duration presets (15s/60s/5m), and a short 'why' required when severity escalates. Show top matched signals inline.
judy: Also want small inline badges for estimated impact (cost delta, invocation delta, p99 delta). Keep numbers coarse (eg +25%/+3ms).
sam: Backend contract: each apply must emit a deterministic breadcrumb id and a telemetry snapshot token for replay. Prefer format: fallback:<YYYYMMDD>T<HHMMSS>:<route-id> and snapshot like ts-20260322-77. No random uuids.
maria: Example audit payload for infra (machine-readable):```{
  "event":"quick_fallback.apply",
  "actor":"judy",
  "rollout":"rollout-99",
  "route":"/v1/complete",
  "mode":"quarantine",
  "severity":"high",
  "duration":"60s",
  "reason":"5xx spike us-east",
  "breadcrumb":"fallback:20260322T101530:/v1/complete",
  "snapshot":"ts-20260322-77"
}```
judy: UI copy should be simple: "Applied quarantine to /v1/complete (60s) 1 reason: 5xx spike in us-east" with a link "view sample traces".
sam: Undo policy: allow a revert button visible for 2 minutes that records a revert audit row (actor + short reason). Rate-limit applies/reverts per rollout (max 2 applies, 3 reverts per 10m) to prevent oscillation.
maria: Permissioning: only users with contingency.apply can escalate to high severity. Show disabled state with tooltip.
ops-bot: Preview available at https://console-preview.internal/quick-fallback?pr=1720 (simulated signals).
judy: I'll write a tiny RFC with the mock, the telemetry contract (breadcrumb + snapshot), example payload above, and the revert/rate-limit rules. Thanks :thumbsup:
